newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH OPPOSITION CENTRE PARTY GAINS MORE -POLL.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH OPPOSITION CENTRE PARTY GAINS MORE -POLL.

text.p: The opposition Centre Party
gained more in an opinion poll in March to just over one
percentage point behind the biggest party in parliament and
government, premier Paavo Lipponen's social democrats, whose
popularity fell slightly, Finnish radio news reported on Friday.
Support for Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto's Conservative
Party, the next biggest group in the five-party left-right-green
coalition, remained steady at slightly over 20 percent.
The monthly survey was made between March 4 and April 2 by
polling institute Taloustutkimus Oy among some 1,900 people.
(Previous surveys also by Taloustutkimus, figs in pct):
March Feb Jan Election '96 Election '95
Leftist Alliance 7.4 9.1 9.1 10.4 11.2
Swedish Party 4.4 4.1 4.7 5.5 5.1
Young Finns 3.5 3.4 3.7 1.3 2.8
Christian League 2.6 3.0 3.3 3.2 3.0
Perussuomalaiset 1.7 1.0 1.0 0.9 1.3
NOTE -- Election '96 is local government election held in
October last year and Election '95 is parliament election held
in March 1995. The next general election is due in March 1999.
NOTE -- Finnish radio said the margin of error in the
Talostutkimus polls is +/- two percentage points.
